prompts.west: Create ONE standalone compact rocky headwater mountain SPRITE for a cute Korean top-down pixel-art trading RPG, isolated on genuine transparent alpha. References: first image is the approved standalone rock mountain STYLE reference; second is the approved large mountain spring/waterfall WATER reference. Make a NEW compact standalone object, not an edit of those files. Important: no horizontal cut-off cliffs or modular open ends. Complete natural silhouette with all rock edges visible. Grey/taupe rock, olive moss, dark brown single-pixel-like outline, broad flat 2-3 tone planes, upper-left lighting, identical art language to references. Design for a final native 160x160 pixel canvas and chunky readable limited palette, no grain, no photorealistic texture, no gradients, no painterly tiny details. A high small aqua spring pool near the upper RIGHT rock shelf feeds a clear white small waterfall diagonally down the front LEFT of the rocky mass. Stream exits at the BOTTOM LEFT of the sprite, occupying the first ~32 pixels of a final 160px-wide canvas, with its center 16px from the left edge. This is a headwater mountain, no lake, no buildings, no characters, no text, no scenery background, no ground rectangle. Keep upper corners and especially upper-left corner transparent, silhouette triangular with an uneven high summit. Base river outlet must visibly reach the bottom image border while rock silhouette stays completely visible. Think attractive polished SNES/GBA pixel RPG environment art, same density and forms as the references. Only one compact mountain spring.
prompts.east: Generate ONE new standalone compact mountain SPRING sprite on genuine transparent alpha, matching the two approved game references. This is an asymmetric SOUTHEAST-OUTLET variant, not a rotated or mirrored sheet and not a copy of the big waterfall. Whole rock mountain silhouette, NO horizontal cut cliff ends. Design for a 160x160 native-pixel canvas: chunky grey/taupe boulders with olive moss, sparse 2-3 flat tone planes, dark brown outline, light from upper LEFT, cute polished SNES/GBA top-down Korean trading RPG. No fine painterly noise, no gradients. Composition: mountain's high peak and small spring pool are in the UPPER LEFT / center-left. Water descends a short clearly visible waterfall over the front rock face, bends naturally to the RIGHT, and exits the BOTTOM RIGHT edge (approximately x=130 of 160) as a narrow turquoise stream with white foam and natural rocky banks. Keep the top-right quadrant transparent: this will sit near a coast and must not cover sea water on that side. Complete natural silhouette with irregular boulder foothills, no rectangular ground base, no surrounding landscape, no buildings, characters or text. Single whole object, clean legible silhouette for shrinking to native game resolution. Ref1 approved rock style; ref2 approved turquoise water/foam and front-facing waterfall material. Use same shapes and palette language, compact with much less height/complexity than ref2.
